none: PAS NLM-AD6BBE: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma Trier mint issue of 330-340, possibly 332-333 (cf. RIC volume 7 no. 547), Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted mantled and cuirassed bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: TRS*. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 2.52gms, die axis: 6
